text: Answer: no field on my menu separates this trend from the deal price. My position read stands as a reading: BULLISH structure, `subcomponents.flow.cmf` 0.42 COM proxy positive, `mp` 97.0, `sc_m_gates` True, buy stop over bar_high (C26, C27). But a name drifting to a fixed deal price can print the same COM and trend, so these fields cannot tell demand from deal arbitrage. Event-driven screening is not my method's test; it is the filter's. If the filter rules WTRG event-driven, it is out of scope and I do not contest it. Until then I hold SUPPORT on my own signal, declared as blind to the deal.
